channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: One in four NFL players who died from 2016-2021 showed signs of CTE
item.description: A study found that at least one in four NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 had evidence of chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE) at the time of death.

item.title: Aficamten trial shows promise for non-obstructive HCM patients
item.description: Treatment with aficamten led to significant improvements in symptoms and exercise capacity for patients with symptomatic non-obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.

item.title: What patients don't say in the dental chair
item.description: A dentist shares a question not found in clinical protocols that often reveals important information from patients.

item.title: Ibrutinib ineffective for high-risk early-stage CLL
item.description: Ibrutinib improves event-free survival in certain genetic subgroups of early-stage chronic lymphocytic leukemia but does not extend overall survival.
